data.name: Larius The Seagull
data.detailed_description:
A Seagull Far From Home

A lone seagull wakes up in a strange and unforgiving land. There is no clear path forward — only wind, hunger, danger...

This is a survival-driven adventure about finding your place in the world.

Survive. Learn. Grow.

The journey is not just about reaching the end of the map. It’s about understanding the environment, adapting to its dangers, and improving with every attempt.

Core Gameplay Features

  • Exploration-focused side-scrolling world
    Travel across diverse areas filled with environmental hazards and hidden safe spots.

  • Survival systems that matter
    Manage health, stamina, and hunger.
    Overexertion, starvation, or careless risks can end your journey.

  • Active movement mechanics
    Walk, jump, peck, and carefully navigate dangerous terrain.

  • Dynamic threats
    Avoid or outmaneuver hostile NPC creatures that react to your presence.

  • Meaningful failure & progression
    Death resets your physical position — but not your experience.
    Each attempt strengthens you, making survival slightly easier and encouraging long-term growth.

More Than Survival

  • Learn lessons from the environment.

  • Overcome increasingly complex dangers.

  • Shape your own path through perseverance and self-improvement.

A Compact but Meaningful Experience

Designed to respect your time while still offering challenge and depth, the game rewards patience, observation, and resilience.

This is not an endless grind.
It is a journey about finding where you belong.

data.short_description: A lost seagull must survive, explore, and find its place in an unfamiliar world. Jump, peck, and navigate through danger while managing hunger, stamina, and health. Learn from failure, grow stronger with each attempt, and push forward in this atmospheric, emotional adventure about resilience.
